Solutions Engineer
Relay Commerce Platform

About us

Relay is a Canadian SaaS company whose platform powers product catalogs, checkout, and order workflows for wholesale brands. Our Solutions Engineering team sits between sales, customers, and product: scoping integrations, building proof-of-concepts, and making technical evaluations succeed.

What you will do

- Partner with account executives on technical discovery calls and demos
- Build proof-of-concept integrations against the Relay REST and GraphQL APIs
- Write integration guides, sample code (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python), and Postman collections
- Debug customer implementations: webhooks, authentication, data mapping, rate limits
- Translate customer feedback into clear product requirements for engineering
- Configure sandbox environments and lead hands-on onboarding workshops
- Respond to RFP technical sections and security questionnaires

What you bring

- 2+ years in a customer-facing technical role (solutions engineering, implementation, support engineering) OR full-stack development experience with strong communication skills
- Working proficiency in JavaScript or Python; you can write and explain real code, not pseudocode
- Hands-on experience with REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, and OAuth flows
- Experience with e-commerce or CRM platforms (Shopify, BigCommerce, HubSpot, Salesforce) is a strong asset
- Ability to run a technical demo for a mixed technical/business audience
- Excellent written English; you will write docs customers actually read

Nice to have

- SQL fluency for data-mapping conversations
- Experience with browser automation or QA tooling
- Familiarity with AI/LLM-powered features and prompt-based configuration

Logistics

Remote within Canada (EST overlap required). $80,000-$100,000 CAD base plus variable. Travel under 10%.
